digest_preservation: skopeo copy --all --preserve-digests reproduces the upstream manifest index byte for byte, so the mirrored digest equals the upstream digest. Any difference means the copy was not faithful and is a refusal.
note: Alpine-based PostgreSQL 16 used by ci, api-test and security-abuse evidence. Kept as a separate logical image: Alpine and Debian builds differ in libc and collation, so unifying them silently could change sort order and index behaviour.
